description: The only capability the WebView holds, and now it scopes the application's own commands as well as the Tauri-provided ones. The application command ACL is switched on (see AGENTS.md section 5), so a command absent from this list is rejected at the IPC boundary rather than silently allowed, which is what an empty list used to mean for application commands. One command still bypasses this file entirely: `plugin:__TAURI_CHANNEL__|fetch` is exempt from the ACL unconditionally, so this list is very nearly, but not quite, the whole of what the WebView may call — see docs/decisions.md. Every `allow-*` entry comes from `../permissions/autogenerated/`, generated out of the command list in `build.rs`: the skeleton's `core_version`, and the conversation commands the shell drives the Claude Code backend with (`src/conversations.rs`) — none of which takes or relays an approval; events reach the WebView on a channel, which needs no entry here. Each entry added here is a widening that AGENTS.md section 5 requires the pull request to state. `core:default` in particular is not such an entry: it is Tauri's aggregate of every core plugin default, which would grant absolute-path resolution, event listen and emit, and the whole menu and tray command set at once — and would leave `core:image`'s from_path inert only for as long as the image-png and image-ico Cargo features stay off, so that setting a PNG tray icon would turn it into an unscoped file read without this file changing.
